```artifact
Feature: Prescription and Consultation Workflow

  Scenario: Generate a single prescription for a patient consultation request
  Given a valid patient consultation request
  When the system processes the request
  Then a single prescription should be generated

  Scenario Outline: Generating prescriptions for multiple consultation requests
  Given <valid or invalid patient consultation request>
  When the system processes the request
  Then <number> of prescriptions should be generated

  Examples:
    | valid patient consultation request | number of prescriptions |
    | true                            | 1                      |
    | false                           | 0                      |

  Scenario: Mapping prescription to a single patient consultation request
  Given a valid prescription
  When the system maps the prescription
  Then it should be mapped to a single patient consultation request

  Examples:
    | valid prescription | valid patient consultation request |
    | true                | true                            |
    | false               | false                           |

  Scenario: Chemist receiving prescriptions
  Given a valid prescription
  When the system sends the prescription to the chemist
  Then the chemist should receive one prescription

  Examples:
    | valid prescription | 1                      |

  Scenario: Lab receiving prescriptions
  Given a valid prescription
  When the system sends the prescription to the lab
  Then the lab should receive one prescription

```
